text:
arjun: FYI starting bring-up for Catalyst Health LoRA blend into base gpt-neox-20b q4 pathway. doing a quick smoke merge + eval pack before we hand to infra for dedicated testing.

lina: awesome — what's the merge strategy? full concat or scaled sum?

arjun: scaled sum, alpha=0.6 (customer wanted stronger personalization). doing weight transform to match q4 quant layout first.

sophia: can you post the exact commands you ran? i'll queue the quickpack.

arjun: here:
```
# convert diff weights and merge
python tools/lora_merge.py \
  --base checkpoints/gpt-neox-20b-q4.pt \
  --lora customer/catalyst/lora_v2.safetensors \
  --out merged/catalyst_v2_q4.pt \
  --alpha 0.6 --quant-format q4_0

# run quick eval pack (synth + customer prompts)
python eval/run_quickpack.py \
  --model merged/catalyst_v2_q4.pt \
  --pack packs/catalyst_quickpack.jsonl \
  --batch 8 --max-tokens 256
```

matt: heads up — merged file sits at 12.6 GB. need to pin to a node with >16GB VRAM for the smoke. i'll allocate a test slot.

deploy-bot: build-job 8247 started on node gpu-a-12 (pinned). docker image: rdinfer/runtime:prod-2026-03-19

qa-bot: quickpack started: 42 prompts (mix of instruction, QA, and med-list extraction). expect ~5-7m.

sophia: note: include the regression set from last cycle (med-loss-v1) — previous finetune had trouble on enumeration tasks.

arjun: included med-loss-v1. running now. partial logs: 
```
[INFO] loading model merged/catalyst_v2_q4.pt
[WARN] quant mismatch: expected q4_0 kernels, fallback to q4_1 for attention_kv
[INFO] running batch 1/6, mean latency 210ms
```

lina: warning on quant mismatch is interesting — might explain perf delta. is that from kernel selection table?

arjun: yes, our kernel selector fell back because the merged tensors had non-aligned strides after the LoRA transform. quick fix attempt: re-chunk weight blobs then repack.

matt: repacking recommended. shipping fallback to q4_1 increases memory use ~8%. ok to proceed?

sophia: quickpack results (summary):
```
- overall chrF: 0.82 (base: 0.84)
- exact_med_list: 0.61 (base: 0.78) <-- regression
- hallucination_rate: 0.05 (base: 0.02)
- latency p50: 220ms (base: 200ms)
```

arjun: ugh. med list regression is material. looks like merge altered tokenization alignment for list outputs. may be due to merged norm biases. will dump a few failing examples.

sophia: please attach 5 failures + expected outputs. I'll tag product for customer communication. keep it concise.

arjun: attaching snippets:
```
PROMPT: "List the medications for hypertension for patient A"
EXPECTED: "lisinopril, amlodipine, hydrochlorothiazide"
MODEL: "amlodipine, lisinopril"  <-- missing HCTZ, order changed
```

lina: two vectors: (1) can we try alpha=0.4 to reduce personalization strength and re-run quickpack? (2) try repack to avoid q4 fallback.

arjun: spawning two runs in parallel (alpha=0.4 + repack). commands:
```
# repack path
python tools/repack_quant.py --input merged/catalyst_v2_q4.pt --out merged/catalyst_v2_q4_repacked.pt

# merge with smaller alpha
python tools/lora_merge.py --base checkpoints/gpt-neox-20b-q4.pt --lora customer/catalyst/lora_v2.safetensors --out merged/catalyst_v2_alpha0.4_q4.pt --alpha 0.4 --quant-format q4_0
```

matt: allocated gpu-b-03 and gpu-b-04 for those jobs. keep runtime image same.

deploy-bot: build-job 8248 started on gpu-b-03 (repack). build-job 8249 started on gpu-b-04 (alpha0.4).

qa-bot: queued quickpack for both. estimated finish 6m. will post diffs.

(6m later)

qa-bot: results: 
```
- repacked version:
  exact_med_list: 0.75, hallucination_rate: 0.03, latency p50: 210ms
- alpha=0.4:
  exact_med_list: 0.79, hallucination_rate: 0.025, latency p50: 215ms
```

sophia: alpha=0.4 almost matches base on med list. repack helped but not enough. both look acceptable to present as options to Catalyst: tradeoff between personalization and fidelity.

arjun: agree. I'll prepare patch notes: include kernel fallback note, recommended alpha=0.4 for production, and a follow-up eval run on the full eval suite before Dedicated.

lina: also add a mitigation: keep a canary route with base model fallback if med-list exactness drops below 0.75 in production checks.

matt: i'll add the routing rule in infra (canary + auto-fallback). needs a small API change but doable.

arjun: new tasks created:
- TICKET-7891: finalize alpha selection & record artifacts
- TICKET-7892: rerun full eval suite (nightly slot)
- TICKET-7893: infra canary + fallback rule

sophia: i'll draft the customer note with the two options and include quickpack summaries. ping if you want me to include sample failed prompts.

lina: great. moving to blocked->in-review. thanks team :thumbsup:

matt: thanks all, will watch for production rollout windows.

arjun: thanks — i'll upload the artifacts to s3://rd-infer/catalyst/bringups/1772106789/ and add checksums in the ticket."
